turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have until 4:40, so tell me why my son has a zero.
I'll stand. I've been sitting since eight this morning. You asked for this meeting, Hale, so start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so answer the question: who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.

No, the zero doesn't stand, and I'm not here to be flattered into it, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Withdraw it, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
